svg.title: RGB sample cloud and its convex hull
svg.desc: A three-dimensional RGB scatter plot sits inside a translucent convex polyhedron. A side note explains that weighted color averages stay inside the hull.
svg.text: A color cloud has a three-dimensional boundary
Every dot is a sampled RGB color. The translucent shell joins the extreme samples.
Any spatial mixture is an average:
Schematic RGB geometry • points and faces are deterministic, not measurements from one image
